19 OCT 2026
LIVE · DASHBOARD IMPROVEMENTS

A clearer IT picture, in 36 seconds.

Assess your IT, save your progress and see what needs attention.

What’s improved

  • Find what matters: results are grouped into five cyber security areas, with simple filters.
  • Retry without starting over: reopen a saved assessment without losing your selection.
  • See the next step: suggested actions and missing evidence are easier to tell apart.
  • Navigate more easily: longer labels fit better, keyboard navigation is clearer and your job title is displayed.

In development: new-account signup, consultant access improvements, editing submitted answers, document uploads and board reports.

13 OCT 2026
EXPLAINER

Sign-in should be simple

We’re working to make signing in and returning to saved work straightforward.

Read the explainer +

Good sign-in should help you get to work quickly while keeping your organisation’s information private.

  • A clear way in: straightforward labels and helpful instructions.
  • A way back: clear account-recovery steps if you lose access.
  • The right access: each person sees the organisations and information they’re allowed to use.
  • Easy to use: forms that work on small screens and with a keyboard.

We’re checking the full process, from account setup to signing out and returning to saved work.
